title: fix(fields): a lookup value picked before the referenced schema loads is labelled from it once it arrives (objectui#10559)
body:
Fixes #10559
Clause-②: no

A lookup value picked before the referenced object's schema loads now labels its chip from that schema once it arrives. Before, a pick cached the BUILT option it was handed, so a pick made while `getObjectSchema` was still pending kept its no-schema label (the `name` guess) for good, while the dropdown option for the same record read the declared `nameField`. This is the pick-path sibling of objectui#10487, and it reuses the mechanism PR objectui#10557 landed for the hydrated value: keep the ROW, derive the option on render.

## Reproduction (base `8cd8eb562`, the card's fixture)

The object's `nameField` is `contract_no`; the rows are `{ id: 'c1', name: 'Acme', contract_no: 'HT-001' }` and `{ id: 'c2', name: 'Initech', contract_no: 'HT-002' }`; quick-create answers `{ id: 'c3', name: 'Globex', contract_no: 'HT-003' }`. The pin's backend holds `getObjectSchema` open until the pick is made and the chip is labelled, then releases it.

| reading | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| dropdown options, before the schema | `Acme`, `Initech` | `Acme`, `Initech` |
| chip after the dropdown pick, before the schema | `Acme` | `Acme` |
| chip after the schema: dropdown pick | `Acme` | `HT-001` |
| chip after the schema: browse-all dialog pick | `Acme` | `HT-001` |
| chip after the schema: quick-create | `Globex` | `HT-003` |
| control: a pick made after the schema loaded | `HT-001` | `HT-001` |
| control: dropdown option after the schema | `HT-001` | `HT-001` |

The mechanism, confirmed at source: `handleSelect` wrote the option into `pickerResolvedRecords`, and `recordToOption` spreads the record over the `label` it builds, so the row behind it was not kept and nothing could rebuild the label. `handlePickerSelectRecords` (the browse-all dialog and the search-first people picker) built its options the same way, with the `refObjectSchema` of the render it ran in. The card called that half NOT MEASURED; the pin measures it, it has the same defect, and it is fixed the same way. Quick-create went through the same cache, and so it had the same defect as well.

## The change: the pick keeps the ROW (one derivation with the hydrated rows)

`packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` only.

- `pickerResolvedRecords` (options) becomes `pickedRecords` (rows), the same shape as `hydratedRecords`.
- `pickedOptions` is derived in the SAME memo that derives `hydratedOptions`, with the same `recordToOption` call and inputs the dropdown's `fetchedOptions` uses: the declared display field, `idField`, the description field, `refObjectSchema`, and the field-read gate of the current policy. No second copy of the derivation, and no relabel effect.
- `mergeRowsByValue` factors the merge the hydration effect already did (keyed by `recordValue`), and the pick cache now merges the same way.
- `findOption` and `findOptionLoose` consult static, fetched, picked, then hydrated options, in the same order as before.

### Which row a pick keeps

- A dropdown pick (click or Enter) goes through `handleSelectCandidate`, which keeps the candidate as served (`previewRows`, keyed by the option's value) with its relations collapsed to ids by `toPredicateRecord`: the row `fetchedOptions` and `recentOptions` build the option from.
- The browse-all dialog and the people picker keep the rows they hand to `onSelectRecords` (the dialog already collapses them). The selection still replaces the kept picks, as it always has.
- Quick-create keeps the created record. Its separate prepend into the cache is gone, because `handleSelect(option, row)` now keeps the row once.
- An authored static option has no row and keeps nothing. `findOption` reads the authored `options` list first on every render, so its chip still resolves.

### What did not change

- The `RecordPickerDialog` JSX props are untouched (PR objectui#10590's region). That PR landed first, and this branch merged `origin/main` after it, with no conflict.
- No `key=` remount, and no fetch to relabel: the pin asserts `findOne` is never called on the pick paths.
- `onSelectRecord` still receives the option handed to the pick.

## Pin: `LookupField.pickedLabel-10559.test.tsx`

| # | row | base | head |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | dropdown: pick before the schema, chip `HT-001` after it, not `Acme`, no `findOne` | red, `Acme` | green |
| 2 | browse-all dialog: the same | red, `Acme` | green |
| 3 | quick-create: the created record reads `HT-003` after the schema, not `Globex` | red, `Globex` | green |
| 4 | control: a pick after the schema loaded reads `HT-001` at once | green | green |
| 5 | control: after the schema, the dropdown option and the chip both read `HT-001` | green | green |

- Committed-state ablation at `8bd04be`: `LookupField.tsx` replaced by the merged-in main parent's blob (`b1030c7`, blob `a1cbd3b45d81`: everything except this fix). Landed: blob matched, `handleSelectCandidate` count 0, `pickerResolvedRecords` count 6. Pin exit 1, `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`, the same three rows. Restored with a trap: blob `1fae07e551e7` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, `handleSelectCandidate` count 5. No `dist/` is involved, because the pin imports `./LookupField`.

## Acceptance notes

- Behaviour note: a picked static option is no longer cached. It resolves from the authored `options` list, which `findOption` reads first. The one case that differs is a value whose option is removed from the authored list after it was picked. Before, the stale cached label still showed. Now it shows no chip. Carrier: none.
- Behaviour note, not changed: a multi-select browse-all confirm hands back only the rows toggled in that dialog session, and the selection replaces the kept picks. So a value held from before the dialog opened loses its kept row and is hydrated again by one fetch. This was already the case before this change. Carrier: none.
- The search-first people picker shares `handlePickerSelectRecords`, so this change covers it too. It has no pin of its own.
- A comment in the objectui#10487 pin's last control ("the chip reads the option the pick cached") now describes the mechanism loosely: the chip reads the option derived from the row the pick kept. The assertion is unaffected, and the file is outside this card's claimed surface, so it is not edited. Carrier: none.
- `origin/main` moved after this branch's merge (`ac2d6f1`, `402a266`; one touches `packages/fields` date widgets and `useFieldTranslation.ts`, not `LookupField.tsx`). `git merge-tree` against it is clean, and it is not merged again here.
